singlechain_msa_protein_legacy.selection: Remove first query record; sort/deduplicate remaining aligned strings; first 2048. Does NOT remove every homolog whose sequence equals WT. Lowercase insertions and dots removed; noncanonical characters treated as invalid/gap per column, not whole-homolog rejection.
singlechain_msa_protein_legacy.weighting: Weight=1/max(neighbors,1); shared valid identity >=0.8 and overlap >=0.5*(end-start+1). Coverage denominator is full selected WT region, not retained-column count.
singlechain_msa_protein_legacy.probability: p(a)=(weighted count(a)+1/20)/(weighted valid column count+1). Total pseudocount 1.
singlechain_msa_protein_legacy.depth: Sum of weights of 20 canonical amino acids in the column; excludes pseudocount.
singlechain_msa_protein_legacy.gap: 1-depth/global_neff. Includes noncanonical symbols encoded invalid, not only literal gaps.
singlechain_msa_protein_legacy.support: low if depth<20 or gap>0.5, otherwise adequate; low-support values remain visible.
singlechain_msa_protein_legacy.unaligned: WT insertion positions receive uniform 1/20, depth 0, gap 1, low support and explicit homolog_column marker upstream. The selected-site packet does not forward this marker.
singlechain_msa_protein_legacy.forwarding: ln(p_mut/p_wt), rounded 5 decimals; depth 3, gap 4 decimals. Raw independent-site sum stored separately.

singlechain_msa_rna_legacy.selection: Reviewed natural homolog source; exact aligned WT mapping; remove record by query_identifier (default WT_query), not by sequence equality; sorted unique aligned strings first 2048. Any ambiguous selected homolog rejects the profile. T->U, dot->gap; FASTA/A3M lowercase insertions removed.
singlechain_msa_rna_legacy.weighting: Inverse >=80% shared-valid identity neighbors with shared valid coverage >=50% of full WT length.
singlechain_msa_rna_legacy.probability: p(base)=(weighted base count+0.25)/(weighted canonical ACGU count+1).
singlechain_msa_rna_legacy.depth: Canonical ACGU weight sum, rounded 3 decimals in upstream profile.
singlechain_msa_rna_legacy.gap: Literal gap weight/global_neff, rounded 5 decimals upstream. Global Neff rounded 3.
singlechain_msa_rna_legacy.support: Computed before rounding: low if valid_weight<20 or gap>0.5; otherwise adequate.
singlechain_msa_rna_legacy.forwarding: Same packet log ratio/depth/gap rounding as protein, from stored frequencies; unavailable natural MSA remains unavailable.

complex_protein_site_msa_legacy.selection: Project homologs to WT match columns; deduplicate; exclude all projected WT-identical homologs and entire ambiguous homologs; lexical first 2048; remove columns unsupported by selected homologs.
complex_protein_site_msa_legacy.weighting: Inverse >=80% shared-valid identity neighbors and >=50% overlap relative to retained-column length.
complex_protein_site_msa_legacy.probability: (weighted amino-acid count+0.05)/(weighted valid column count+1); global_neff=sum(weights).
complex_protein_site_msa_legacy.missing: Current features.py: unsupported retained-column lookup => null numeric evidence. Historical frozen features.py SHA 0c3715... instead set weighted_valid_count=0, weighted_gap_fraction=1, weighted_unknown_fraction=0 while probabilities/log ratio remained null and status=no_valid_homolog_at_column. This historical exception is present in PPI prompts. Unknown fraction on valid retained columns is zero after whole-homolog filtering.
complex_protein_site_msa_legacy.gate: status ok requires mapping/WT match/supported column and global_neff>=20. Generic renderer can expose low-Neff frequencies with status; DNA shown_evidence removes log ratio and nulls frequencies/counts for non-ok rows.
complex_protein_site_msa_legacy.independent_score: Legacy score requires every site ok; sum natural log ratios; no epistasis model.

protein_rna_msa_v2.selection: Valid unique non-WT projected homologs ordered by SHA256 of literal 42 + newline + sequence, first 2048; no label-dependent selection.
protein_rna_msa_v2.weighting: Same 80%/50% retained-column inverse-neighbor weighting and amino-acid total pseudocount 1 as complex profile.
protein_rna_msa_v2.gate: Keep low Neff as global_neff_below_frozen_20 quality flag. Independent score accepts ok OR this low-Neff status when site valid count>0 and log ratio finite. Legacy strict score retained separately.
protein_rna_msa_v2.scope: Protein mutation-site MSA; not an RNA-partner MSA algorithm.

singlechain_protein_structure_legacy.mapping: Unique entire-chain WT exact match, first MODEL. Canonical ATOM plus MSE HETATM. Sequence coordinate separate from PDB numbering.
singlechain_protein_structure_legacy.altloc: Geometry per-atom highest occupancy; ties favor blank then A. SASA uses Bio.PDB selected atoms independently.
singlechain_protein_structure_legacy.plddt: CA B-factor only if caller explicitly asserts AlphaFold provenance and value in [0,100], else null.
singlechain_protein_structure_legacy.contacts: ca_contact_count_8a upstream -> nonlocal_ca_contacts_8a packet; intrachain CA distance<=8 A, exclude |i-j|<=2. Counts observed CA neighbors only.
singlechain_protein_structure_legacy.nearest: Up to 3 nearest observed eligible CA atoms, no 8 A cutoff; distance rounded 2 decimals.
singlechain_protein_structure_legacy.sasa: Isolated matched chain; remove waters/ligands except MSE; Bio.PDB ShrakeRupley probe 1.4 A/100 points, residue sum rounded 2 decimals. No explicit missing-heavy-atom completeness gate; atom set is what Bio.PDB retains, not forced heavy-only.
singlechain_protein_structure_legacy.packet: Does not forward upstream contacts_complete, nonlocal_ca_expected/observed, sasa_caveat, provenance assertion or alternate_atom_names.

singlechain_rna_structure_legacy.mapping: ATOM canonical ACGU, blank/A altloc; unique whole-WT chain; sorted chain/residue/insertion. Anchor C4-prime -> C1-prime -> P. Parser does not itself isolate MODEL; current 31 files each have a single model.
singlechain_rna_structure_legacy.contacts: Count remaining anchors <=8 A after excluding |i-j|<=3; nearest 3 without cutoff, distance rounded 2 decimals.
singlechain_rna_structure_legacy.confidence_actual: packet reads anchor B-factor when structure_kind=predicted_WT. 20 historical mapped files had B-factor overwritten to zero by annotate_cif, so those packet zeros are NOT valid pLDDT. Ten Gemmi-converted AF3 files preserve original confidence; one experimental structure has null packet pLDDT.
singlechain_rna_structure_legacy.confidence_required: For a future version use verified original CIF atom confidence with explicit atom/coordinate mapping, or null+unavailable if provenance cannot establish confidence. Do not rewrite historical packets.

complex_protein_site_structure_legacy.model: First PDB model; only task-frozen residue IDs in the two explicit disjoint partner groups; finite heavy atoms, exclude H/D.
complex_protein_site_structure_legacy.altloc: Per-residue coherent alternative: maximize summed occupancy, then atom count, then prefer A, then label; retain shared blank atoms; duplicate atom name chooses higher occupancy.
complex_protein_site_structure_legacy.partner: Opposite frozen group, not nearest chain. Both heavy/light antibody chains remain in their own group when partners removed.
complex_protein_site_structure_legacy.distance: Minimum of all WT residue-heavy to specified partner-heavy atom distances.
complex_protein_site_structure_legacy.contacts: Number of distinct partner residues with any atom <=5 A, not atom pairs.
complex_protein_site_structure_legacy.sasa: ShrakeRupley 1.4 A,100 points. Site needs N/CA/C/O plus expected WT sidechain heavy atoms. SASA missing=>null; distance/contact may still use observed atoms.
complex_protein_site_structure_legacy.delta_sasa: SASA of this residue in own-group-only environment minus same residue SASA in the two-group bound environment. Not whole-group surface area.

protein_rna_structure_contact_legacy.scope: Uses reviewed structure_v3 scope; only three eligible assays get contact evidence; other seven reuse base requests exactly.
protein_rna_structure_contact_legacy.geometry: First model; coherent residue altloc; specified protein/RNA polymers with explicit reviewed RNA instances, modified-atom classification and coordinate completeness checks. WT sidechain and whole-residue distances are separate upstream fields.
protein_rna_structure_contact_legacy.actual_boolean: direct_rna_contact = whole-residue partner_contact_count_5A > 0. Current guidance incorrectly says sidechain heavy atoms.
protein_rna_structure_contact_legacy.actual_moieties: Base/ribose/phosphate classes from all whole-residue heavy-atom contacts, emitted only with contact and complete classification; not restricted to sidechain.
protein_rna_structure_contact_legacy.visibility: Only site_id, direct_rna_contact and optional rna_contact_moieties sent; distances/counts/SASA remain audit-only.
protein_rna_structure_contact_legacy.required: Future description must say WT residue heavy atoms including backbone, OR a separately versioned sidechain-only computation must be defined and re-evaluated. Do not silently relabel the frozen results.

protein_ligand_structure_legacy.model: First PDB model; preserve all base-input protein chains/residue IDs plus every HETATM instance matching annotated ligand residue name; exclude water/other ligand/cofactor names.
protein_ligand_structure_legacy.altloc: Bio.PDB default per-atom highest-occupancy conformer; differs from coherent residue altloc in generic complex builder.
protein_ligand_structure_legacy.distance: Minimum site-heavy to annotated-ligand-heavy atom distance.
protein_ligand_structure_legacy.contacts: Number of distinct specified ligand heavy atoms with any site heavy atom <=5 A.
protein_ligand_structure_legacy.sasa: ShrakeRupley 1.4 A/100 points; all base protein chains plus matching ligand copies. Delta is same WT residue SASA after removing only these ligands minus bound SASA; complete WT heavy atoms required, errors=>null.

admet_molecule_structure_legacy.optimization: MMFF94 if all parameters available, otherwise UFF; numThreads=1,maxIters=100. Return statuses/energies ignored; no energy-ranked best-conformer selection and no convergence guarantee.
admet_molecule_structure_legacy.aggregation: Descriptor calculated on every returned optimized conformer; componentwise median rounded 4 decimals. Remaining19 caches identical SMILES but preserves endpoint rows.
admet_molecule_structure_legacy.atom_scope: Explicit H retained. NPR1/NPR2, RadiusOfGyration, Asphericity use atomic masses by default; Spherocity uses unweighted gyration eigenvalues.
admet_molecule_structure_legacy.versions: Historical producer source SHA and frozen files verified; recorded RDKit 2026.03.6. Audit environment 2025.09.4 used only for synthetic unit scaling, not regeneration.

descriptor_definitions.Asphericity: 0.5*sum(pairwise squared differences of mass-weighted gyration eigenvalues)/(sum of these eigenvalues)^2
descriptor_definitions.SpherocityIndex: 3*smallest unweighted gyration eigenvalue/sum of unweighted gyration eigenvalues
descriptor_definitions.PBF: RDKit CalcPBF plane-of-best-fit descriptor; length dimension verified independently by synthetic coordinate scaling
